reviewItem.question: For "Storage version of `updaterequests.kyverno.io` changes v1beta1 → v2", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether any UpdateRequest objects exist in the cluster stored as v1beta1 (Kyverno creates UpdateRequests at runtime for mutate/generate policies, so stored-object state is not visible in manifests)

proposed.statement: The storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD changed from v1beta1 to v2 (v1beta1.storage true→false, v2.storage false→true between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0), so existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update is required before a later release removes v1beta1.
